items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal to fell the beech tree
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch bei der Stadt Musterfreiburg, Rathausplatz 2–4, 79098 Musterfreiburg, zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Wed 02.12.2026, no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' given so the printed date is the posting date. This is a municipal authority (Stadt Musterfreiburg, Garten- und Tiefbauamt), not a tax office, so the delivery day is the 4th day after posting and does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend (§ 41 Abs. 2 LVwVfG, as the letter itself states). 02.12.2026 + 4 days = Sun 06.12.2026 → deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on Sun 06.12.2026. Widerspruch period is one month after Bekanntgabe (§ 70 VwGO analog, per the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; a one-month period starting from an event on 06.12.2026 ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 06.01.2027 (Wednesday). 06.01.2027 is Epiphany (Heilige Drei Könige), a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so under § 31 Abs. 3 LVwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Thursday 07.01.2027 (not a weekend or holiday).
